notes_for_editor: NRHP OCR garbled (1873/1874 digits); 1873 start from NPS. Fog signal: LHB 1896 act 11 June 1896 $5,600; NPS says 1897 and $5,500 (the 1893 authorisation figure); LF gives 1 Sept 1897 first operation, NPS says first apparatus failed and replacement came a year later. NPS says Coast Guard replaced civilians 1945 but USLHS roster lists keepers to 1958 (probably Coast Guard officers in charge, unconfirmed). Roster lines from USLHS only; LF spells Boesler Sr./Midgett/Gigaudet differently. NY Herald 1874 notice OCR shows 'Ant 12, 1874' for the date lit, unresolved. Page numbers for 1899 and 1901 reports are scan pages. 1921 Bulletin: list of efficiency-flag stations, year of flag 1921 by volume. Kiowa story is Hamringa's own report as printed in the Bulletin (1930 volume); Bulletin gives night of Dec 1 for commendation. No photos researched.
